name: account-menu
title: Account Menu
description: The menu opened from the avatar: name, email and plan, a dotted credit meter with credits left and used, up to two upsell rows for more credits, then settings, help and sign out.

meta.use_when: You need the avatar menu of a signed-in app where people check who they are signed in as, how many credits they have left, buy more, and reach settings, help or sign out
